# ParcelStream Business Rates

ParcelStream helps growing businesses ship parcels across the country with dependable delivery times and transparent pricing. Our business accounts give you discounted rates, scheduled collections and a single dashboard for tracking every shipment.

## Ground service

ParcelStream Ground is our most popular service for business shipments. It covers parcels up to thirty kilograms and includes tracking, delivery confirmation and two delivery attempts before a parcel is held at a local pickup point.

FACT: ParcelStream ground delivery takes 3 business days on average nationwide.
FACT: ParcelStream charges 8 dollars per parcel for ground shipments under 5 kg.
FACT: ParcelStream charges 4 dollars for each scheduled pickup.

## Express options

For urgent shipments, ParcelStream Express delivers the next business day to most addresses. Express rates depend on weight and destination zone, and a cut-off time applies for same-day collection.

## Volume discounts

Businesses that ship more than three hundred parcels a month qualify for tiered discounts on ground rates. Discounts are reviewed every quarter based on actual volume, so growing businesses benefit automatically without renegotiating their contract.

## Integrations

ParcelStream connects with leading ecommerce platforms and order management systems. Labels can be printed in bulk, and tracking updates are pushed back to the online store so customers always know where their order is.

## Returns

Our prepaid returns labels make it simple for customers to send items back. Businesses are charged only when a returns label is actually used.

## Claims

Every ground parcel includes basic loss and damage cover. Additional cover can be purchased for high-value items, and claims are processed within ten business days.
